'''Reed''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Reed was posted aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'', a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that housed a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] which contained various wanted [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. After the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] was captured by Republic forces while [[Raid on the Republic hypermatter refinery|attacking]] a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] [[Unidentified Republic hypermatter refinery|refinery]], he was taken to the ''Tempestuous'' and escorted to a cell by Reed and fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cale (clone trooper)|Cale]]. However, moments later Das and the prisoner [[Arlain Zee]] [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|escaped]] from their cells, and the pair attacked and incapacitated Cale and Reed. Das and Zee then stole their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armors]]. Zee took Reed's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while Das put on Cale's armor, until the Iktotchi realized he could not fit his head into the [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="Lockdown" />
